Name: Area Under the Curve (AUC)
Description: Area Under the Curve (AUC) is a mathematical integration method used to summarize the cumulative magnitude of a measured response over time or across a range of conditions. In biological research, AUC is applied to diverse data types: antibody binding curves, dose-response relationships, viral load kinetics, cytokine secretion time courses, and analyte abundance profiles. The calculation integrates the area between the response curve and the baseline (typically via the trapezoidal rule), yielding a single scalar value that captures both the intensity and duration of the measured response. AUC values enable standardized comparison across experimental groups, time points, or treatment conditions.
